A bright, adorable adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. FRAME: a square 1:1 (1024×1024) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

SCENE (chosen):

Small moment: a pen, a small notebook and a few loose objects drift weightlessly around her.
Outfit: a pirate captain party costume — a cropped brocade coat over a cinched waist, a tricorn hat and tall boots; styled with a few thin stacked bangles on one wrist

SUPPORT: nothing holds her up — she floats free in weightlessness.

Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.

PROP: with her own right hand she sips from a squeezable drink pouch through its short straw; it is all she holds.

overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; chest and pelvis covered
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: balanced — her species shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face and hair — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty.
